title: Assign player short IDs on the server instead of bridge-local
description:
Currently, player UUIDs (TestPlayer, Opponent) get bridge-local short IDs (l-prefix) via ShortIdRegistry.getOrAssign() because players aren't card views and don't flow through GameView.assignShortIds(). This creates a split namespace: cards use server-assigned p-prefix IDs, players use bridge-local l-prefix IDs.

We should investigate all places where local IDs are assigned on the bridge side and try to get them assigned by the server instead, so the LLM sees a single consistent namespace.

Places to investigate:
- Player UUIDs in GAME_TARGET choices (e.g. targeting Opponent with Lightning Bolt)
- Cards in lookedAt zone (findCardViewById doesn't search lookedAt, so they get local IDs initially)
- Any other UUIDs that go through bridge getOrAssign() instead of server register()

For each case, file a sub-issue with the specific fix needed. The goal is to minimize the number of objects that need bridge-local IDs.
